prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for an interactive modern fantasy world map titled Rune Metropolis: Resonance. Elegant richly detailed top-down illustrated cartography, warm ivory paper, delicate crisp ink outlines, softly painted natural terrain, small architectural footprints, modern urban technology coexisting with magic. Orthographic overhead map, no horizon, no isometric angle. Lively and detailed but readable beneath code-rendered place markers. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, legends, labels, pins, icons, compass, UI, watermark or decorative outer frame. Full bleed landscape image. One seamless world overview, aspect ratio 10:7. Normalized 1000x700 canvas. Central modern city spans x300-730/y130-560, six districts: floating academy at (510,200), business civic center (510,335), old winding town (375,370), landscaped housing (500,485), artisan trading quarter (640,380), seaside harbor (660,505). Around it: white-stone kingdom northwest (180,140); dark industrial imperial area northeast (820,150); icy mountains and ecological dome at far north (500,65); blossom-rich forest island east (855,330); steampunk double city southeast (770,590), light upper terrace and darker lower quarter; pirate ocean harbor south (510,625); desert ruins southwest (200,580); sacred mountains far west (95,365); fog-covered cursed archipelago far southeast (860,540); separate small dreamlike pocket-realm inset at far southwest (80,610). Draw broad regional contours, mountain ridges, clear blue sea along southern and eastern coastline, river corridors, light road networks linking city neighborhoods. No named landmark symbols. The main city should remain visible and calm, outer terrains distinct. This is an original fictional schematic atlas, not a reproduction of an official game map.
